track: The River of Renewal - Self Hypnosis
voice_direction: mature male, warm, low, unhurried, near-monotone, intimate; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is a relaxation and healing visualization... created for rest, and personal growth. It is not a medical treatment... and it never replaces the care of your doctors. Never listen in a moving vehicle... or at any time when you need your full, awakened attention.

For if you have been tired... in a way that sleep does not seem to reach... if your body has been holding tension... you never asked it to hold... a heaviness in the shoulders... in the back... behind the eyes... and if some quiet part of you... has simply been asking... for care...

...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed. Tonight... there is nothing to fix... nothing to force. Your body already knows the way... your only task... is to rest... and let the river... do what rivers do.
Let your body settle... heavy... and warm. Take one slow breath in... and let it go. And another... deeper... and as it leaves... feel your shoulders drop... your jaw loosen... your eyes grow soft.

And as you breathe... you may begin to notice... a sound... somewhere between hearing... and remembering... the low... steady... sound of water... moving in the dark... a great river... flowing through the night.
With each breath... you drift a little closer to the banks. The day lets go of you... the sounds of the house... the weight of your hands... all carried downstream... farther... and farther away.

And now... bring your attention gently... to the quiet rhythm beneath everything... the soft... faithful... pulse of your own heart. Not straining to feel it... just noticing... warmth moving beneath the skin... the first lantern... on the water.

Now... in your mind... you stand on the bank of the great river... at night. Moonlight on slow water... wide... and calm... and deep. The air is cool... the water is warm... and the river... is glad... to see you.

For this river... has been flowing inside you... since before you were born. Sixty thousand miles of waterways... they say... branching... rejoining... reaching every village... every outpost... of the body. And tonight... you are here... simply to watch it flow.

Look... out on the dark water... small boats... moving with the current... each carrying a lantern... and a quiet cargo. Oxygen... from the lungs... nourishment... from the food you have eaten... messages... from one village... to another.

And at the head of it all... the great spring that never rests... your heart... pouring itself into the river... beat... after beat... after beat. It has never once forgotten you. Rest here on the warm bank... and let the current... carry you deeper.
For every beat of your heart... is a lantern... set upon the water.
Blood moves through you... the way moonlight moves on a slow current... quietly... everywhere at once.
For the narrowest stream in you... the smallest capillary... is wide enough... for what it carries.
Oxygen... loosening from its little boat... stepping ashore... exactly where it is needed.
Warmth... is only the river... arriving.
And tonight... deep rest... opens the water. The banks widen... the current slows... and the small boats drift... where the day kept them hurrying.
For nothing in the body works harder... than when you finally... let it be easy.
Perhaps you can feel it now... warmth gathering in your hands... in your feet... the far banks... lighting their lamps.
The smallest villages... the tips of your fingers... the soles of your feet... receiving their boats... tonight.
For every tissue... every fiber... every cell... lives on the riverbank... and all of them... are home tonight.
You may notice the water running clearer... as you rest... the day's sediment... settling gently... to the bottom.
Tension... is only a place where the river narrows... and rest... widens it... again.
For you do not steer this river... it steers itself... wisely... as it always has.
Perhaps a slow warmth is spreading across your shoulders now... meltwater... finding its way... down the mountain.
And the tired places... the ones that have been asking... are the very banks... the river visits first.
For the body keeps no account of your worry... it keeps only the rhythm... and the rhythm... is steady.
Each breath... a soft rain... feeding the headwaters.
Each heartbeat... a quiet promise... kept.
And the river does not hurry... and yet... it has never once... been late.
For what the day has worn... the night can wash... clean... and clear.
You might imagine every cell... leaning down to the water... cupping its hands... drinking.
And the water gives... without being asked... the way deep water... always gives.
Each time you return to this river... the banks grow greener... the current... kinder.
For rest is not empty time... it is the river's hour... to carry more.
And tomorrow... in some ordinary moment... you will feel it... a warmth in your hands... the river... still with you.
For the river was flowing before you learned its name... and it will flow... the whole night through.
You need only rest... and the river... does the rest.
And now... it is time to leave the banks... just for tonight. The boats keep moving... the lanterns stay lit... the river does not need you... to watch it flow.
Feel yourself rising... back to your own size... your own body... heavy and warm... the room around you... the night around the room.
And the warmth you found on the banks... stays with you. In your hands... in your chest... a quiet lantern... that does not go out.
If you are ready for sleep... you may drift now... into deep, repairing sleep... the kind in which the river... does its finest carrying.
Or if you are waking... take one deeper breath... and feel yourself arriving... clear... calm... watered... and whole.
Either way... the invitation has been given. The current is open. The boats are moving... and the villages... are fed.
Rest now. The night is wide... the water is warm... and everything you need... is already on its way.
For you are... the river... and your body... remembers the way.
